title: Morbier and Carrot Tart
description: A French dessert featuring a rich, creamy Morbier cheese filling and caramelized carrots, all topped with a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Make the pastry dough by combining flour, butter, and salt in a bowl. Roll out to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the dough in a tart pan and trim the edges.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the grated carrot, cinnamon, and Morbier cheese to the egg mixture and stir until combined.
Pour the filling into the pastry-lined tart pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden and the filling is set.
Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rack for at least 10 minutes before serving.
